assignments.title: Speaking Task — Ma famille
assignments.html: Record 6–8 sentences introducing your family and describing what each person is like. Include at least five adjectives (with correct m./f. agreement), one irregular adjective ( beau / nouveau / vieux ), one correctly placed BANGS adjective, and the verb faire once. Speak from notes, not a full script. You may re-record before submitting.

assignments.title: Speaking Task — Décris une région
assignments.html: Record 6–8 sentences describing one French region of your choice (Bretagne, Alsace, Provence, or Normandie). Say where it is (a compass phrase), name at least three landscape words , and use at least one demonstrative ( cette région, ces plages ) and the preposition en . Speak from notes, not a full script. You may re-record before submitting.

assignments.title: Speaking Task — Au restaurant
assignments.html: Record 6–8 sentences ordering a full meal at a restaurant, in order. Use prendre at least twice, at least one partitive ( du / de la / des ), and at least one quantity expression ( une tranche de, une bouteille de ). Open with Je voudrais commander and close with L'addition, s'il vous plaît . Speak from notes, not a full script. You may re-record before submitting.

assignments.title: Speaking Task — Mon week-end dernier
assignments.html: Record 6–8 sentences describing what you did last weekend, in order — all in the passé composé. Include at least five verbs in the past , one irregular participle ( fait, vu, pris ), one negative sentence ( je n'ai pas… ), and one time expression ( hier soir, samedi ). Speak from notes, not a full script. You may re-record before submitting.

assignments.title: Speaking Task — Ta journée en ville
assignments.html: Record 6–8 sentences narrating a trip through a city in the past, in order. Include at least five être verbs (with correct agreement), one negative ( ne…pas ), one transport word, and one landmark . Speak from notes, not a full script. You may re-record before submitting.

assignments.title: Speaking Task — Un souvenir d'art
assignments.html: Record 6–8 sentences describing a memory tied to art, a museum, a movie, or a place you used to go. Use at least three imparfait verbs (description / habit) and at least two passé composé verbs (events that happened), plus at least two Module 6 art words . Speak from notes, not a full script. You may re-record before submitting.

assignments.title: Speaking Task — Une journée de shopping
assignments.html: Record 6–8 sentences describing a shopping trip — real or imagined. Include at least five clothing/shopping words , at least three direct object pronouns ( le, la, l', les ), and one sentence in the past ( je l'ai achetée ). Speak from notes, not a full script. You may re-record before submitting.

assignments.title: Speaking Task — Compare deux artistes
assignments.html: Record 6–8 sentences comparing two singers, bands, or concerts you know. Include at least two comparatives ( plus / moins / aussi…que ), one use of mieux or meilleur , and one lui or leur (what you would say or give to one of them). Speak from notes, not a full script. You may re-record before submitting.

assignments.title: Speaking Task — Mon année de français
assignments.html: Record 6–8 sentences reflecting on your year of French and what being French means to you. Include at least one superlative ( le plus, le meilleur ), one voudrais wish, one passé composé and one imparfait , and one identity word ( la culture, la devise, la langue… ). Speak from notes, not a full script. You may re-record before submitting.
